notes: Seed URL redirects to /government/departments/elections-voter-registration, which links yearly results pages. Fort Bend's Clarity elections.json does not list the three elections, so EIDs were taken from the county's own result pages: 2024 Election Results 'November 5, 2024-Presidential Election Official Results' -> results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Fort_Bend/122596; 2026 Election Results 'March 3, 2026-Joint Primary Election Official Results' -> 125940 and 'May 26, 2026-Primary Runoff Election Official Results' -> 126372. Each detail.xml read shows Region 'Fort Bend' and the matching ElectionDate. Check 1: 2024 general 6 election-night updates (7:12 PM to 12:48 AM CST), each with 173 precincts with nonzero votes, summed precinct votes rising from 8,687,231 to 10,583,005; 2026 primary 5 updates (7:07 PM to 1:47 AM CST), 197 precincts, sums 4,498,492 to 6,515,381; 2026 runoff 4 updates (7:17 PM to 12:03 AM CDT), 195 precincts, sums 259,547 to 385,727. The first update each night carries early-vote precinct numbers; later updates add election-day votes at precinct level. Some early versions had no readable detail file (7, 9 and 5). Check 3 not needed.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (precinct numbers in several election-night Clarity updates), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.
